## Overview

This website contains research notebooks exploring heterogeneous infection kernels for epidemic modeling. We focus on social contagion across Twitter and Operation Outbreak datasets.

## Research Notes

Navigate using the sidebar to view notebooks organized by date. All research notes are cached and frozen to ensure reproducible results over time.
